description_en: Queries the compliance summary based on the compliance evaluation result of a rule
description_zh: 从规则的合规评估结果维度查询合规概要
kebab_example: aliyun config get-resource-compliance-by-config-rule --compliance-type COMPLIANT --config-rule-id cr-d369626622af008e0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResourceComplianceByConfigRule

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resources are evaluated as compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: The resources are evaluated as non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule does not apply to the resources.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

Compliances.description_en: The compliance evaluation results based on compliance types

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation results of the resources. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The resource was evaluated as compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: The resource was evaluated as incompliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule did not apply to your resources.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No resource data was available
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

Count.description_en: The number of resources that have compliance evaluation results. For example, if the value of the `ComplianceType` parameter is `COMPLIANT`, this parameter value indicates the number of compliant resources
Count.description_zh: 符合评估结果的资源数。例如：`ComplianceType`为`COMPLIANT`，表示合规的资源数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of evaluated resources
